hosted_execution_limitation: The hosted worker has GitHub connector access but no repository checkout/networked local repo. Exact current-module execution is therefore left to the Ubuntu/repo executor; no PASS is claimed from the mirror probe.

A_strengths: semantic root excludes event ids/timestamps/writer/provenance and therefore represents current semantic content independently of history
explicit snapshot export/restore with provenance-bound recovery event
A_defects_or_gaps: typed $kind=set semantics are not canonicalized as sets
idempotent replay checks only idempotency key plus event_id, so a changed semantic payload with the same pair can be silently treated as replay
B_strengths: typed set versus ordered collection canonicalization
separate semantic event, semantic chain, execution chain and trace-root identities
idempotency fingerprint rejects changed semantic/provenance/source payload
B_defects_or_gaps: semantic_state_hash includes global epoch, domain epochs and semantic history chain, so identical current semantic content reached through different event groupings hashes differently
no full verify method over event/state chains
execution metadata is outside the idempotency fingerprint and needs an explicit retry/attempt receipt contract
